items.title: What Is a Barcode? Definition, How It Works, and Types
items.desc: Barcodes are on almost every product you buy. Learn how they work, their brief history, and the most commonly used types of barcodes.

items.title: What Is a QR Code and How Does It Work?
items.desc: A QR Code can store links, text, and even WiFi details, and it stays readable even when partly damaged. Here is how it works and what makes it useful.

items.title: How to Create a Free QR Code in 3 Steps
items.desc: A practical guide to creating QR Codes for links, WiFi, contacts, or WhatsApp with no app and no sign-up, complete with tips to make them easy to scan.

items.title: 1D vs 2D Barcodes: Which One Do You Need?
items.desc: Line barcodes and QR Codes are both barcodes, but they serve different purposes. Compare their capacity, how they are scanned, and examples of their use.

items.title: How to Get an EAN-13 Product Barcode for Small Businesses
items.desc: Want your products in convenience stores or supermarkets? Learn what the EAN-13 digits mean, how to register an official number with GS1 Indonesia, and how to print it.

items.title: How to Create a WiFi QR Code So Guests Don't Have to Type the Password
items.desc: Guests just scan a QR Code to connect to WiFi. Ideal for cafés, offices, guesthouses, and homes. Here is how to create one and put it up.

items.title: The Right Barcode Size and Resolution for Printing
items.desc: Barcodes that are too small or blurry are hard to scan. Learn the minimum sizes, the scanning distance rule, and safe image resolutions for printing.

items.title: 7 Reasons a Barcode Won't Scan and How to Fix Them
items.desc: Is your barcode or QR Code failing to scan? Check the seven most common causes, from color contrast to size, along with how to fix them.

items.title: QR Codes for Restaurant Menus: A Complete Guide
items.desc: A digital menu via QR Code makes things easier for customers and saves on printing costs. Here is how to create one, prepare the menu, and place it on tables.

items.title: Creative QR Code Designs That Can Still Be Scanned
items.desc: QR Codes can be shaped like a heart or a circle, or given frames and colors. Learn the rules for keeping the design attractive and easy to scan at the same time.
